2.t: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—

3.t: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less

4.t: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way

5.t: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation

6.t: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation
6.tr: Inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat-anw Wa-aqwamu qeelaa

7.t: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺
7.tr: Inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa

8.t: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
8.tr: Wazkuris ma rabbika Wa-tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa

9.t: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs
9.tr: Rabbul mashriqi wal-maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa

10.t: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously
10.tr: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo-loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa

11.t: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while
11.tr: Wa-zarnee walmukaz-zibeena ulin na'mati Wa-mahhilhum qaleelaa

12.t: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire

13.t: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺

14.t: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand
14.tr: Yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu Wa-kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa

15.t: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh
15.tr: Innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shaahidan 'aleykum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa Fir'awna rasoolaa

16.t: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip
16.tr: Fa'asaa Fir'awnur Rasoola fa-akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa

17.t: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey
17.tr: Fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba

18.t: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled
18.tr: Assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola

19.t: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord
19.tr: Inna haazihee tazkiratun fa-man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa Rabbihee sabeelaa

20.t: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
20.tr: Inna Rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa-yil laili Wa-nisfahoo Wa-sulusahoo Wa-taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal-laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna-haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa-yakoonu minkum mardaa Wa-aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi Wa-aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu Wa-aqeemus salaata Wa-aatuz zakaata Wa-aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; Wa-maa tuqadimoo li-anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw Wa-a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.
